notes.title: Playtest available till middle of September
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42014435/4215fb25f0de20907222b34c4eb47658aecb344c.png[/img]

As part of[url=https://itch.io/jam/feedback-quest-8-indiegames-x-indie-streamers] Feedback Quest 8[/url], we have made our Playtest available again!

This playtest will be available until the middle of September, so do try it out and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1916560/discussions/0/]let us know what you think[/url] in the Steam discussion forums! If you've never played Feisty Fauna before, we recommend that you play the demo to experience the tutorial and first level, before trying out the levels in the playtest.

Feisty Fauna's campaign is complete, and in this playtest, you'll be able to experience the last 3 levels of the campaign. In particular, you will explore the Fungi Fields and Wintry Woods biomes, meet new characters, and learn more about the storyline.

[b]Warning[/b]: you will see spoilers to the story if you haven't played the first 3 levels in earlier playtests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42014435/304a6967f4ca54b91790723cc08dce72aa7f29e8.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42014435/82698b63a60af6d915f2e9f772e6f121ce8c3984.gif[/img]

notes.title: Campaign done!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that the campaign for Feisty Fauna is complete! There are 6 levels in the campaign, telling the story of Peppermint rescuing her kidnapped chicks, and getting to know other feisty fauna through the process.

In the campaign, you will traverse three different biomes: Groovy Grassland, Fungi Fields, and Wintry Woods. Here's a sneak peak of Fungi Fields and Wintry Woods:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42014435/304a6967f4ca54b91790723cc08dce72aa7f29e8.gif[/img]
Yes, there will be dinosaurs (some with poison) in Fungi Fields ☺️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42014435/82698b63a60af6d915f2e9f772e6f121ce8c3984.gif[/img]
And you will encounter ice golems in Wintry Woods 🥶

We are excited to share this update with you, as we continue our game development process and polishing the game for release!

notes.title: Playtest available till end of March
notes.content:
As part of[url=https://itch.io/jam/feedback-quest-6-get-your-game-reviewed] Feedback Quest 6[/url], we have made our Playtest available again!

This playtest will be available until the end of March, so do try it out and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1916560/discussions/0/]let us know what you think[/url]!

Playtest-only changes:
[list]
[*] During the game (outside of the farm), you can now change the camera angle! To do so, you can use the right joystick on the gamepad, or right-click and drag the mouse. The camera angle is not currently saved across levels.
[*] There are 3 campaign levels available in the playtest, which completes the first story beat of the campaign.
[*] Besides Peppermint and Vanilla, Honey the loving dog is also available as a playable character in the campaign (if you unlock her).
[*] Eclair is a new shop NPC that you may encounter in the campaign, and she offers unique buffs you can purchase with coins.
[*] The Lunar New Year level is disabled for this playtest. If you wish to play that level, you can do so through our demo.
[*] We have not completed translations / localization for the new campaign levels, so please do not switch languages during the playtest.
[/list]

Other changes:
[list]
[*] Levels can now have alternate objectives, i.e., Do A [i]or[/i] B. You may encounter one of more of these in the campaign.
[*] Player buffs (e.g., damage, speed, defense etc) are now unique across campaign playthroughs. Coins earned from all games (including classic mode) are cumulative, so any coins you earn anywhere will help future playthroughs.
[*] Wolves, being smarter than foxes, now jump in front of the player's position.
[/list]

Bug fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where newly-spawned creatures would run away at the beginning of a level
[/list]

notes.title: Game balancing for campaign
notes.content:
We've balanced the difficulty of the campaign levels. Our general philosophy for difficulty levels is: for the Spicy (Medium) difficulty, new players should be able to complete it without dying, but it may feel a little challenging at times. For veteran players of the genre, Feisty (Hard) difficulty should be more your style! The Cozy (Easy) difficulty is for players who seldom/never play similar games, and would like to enjoy the game without worrying (too much) about dying.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42014435/ed00f88fcaebba63ceb13905ec4c08adf6ccf41e.gif[/img]

If you find the game too easy/difficult, please experiment with the 3 difficulty modes and also the sliders! The sliders allow you to customize different aspects of the game's difficulty, ranging from the number of enemies, to their heath, their damage, attack speed, and so on!

As always, we would love to hear your feedback about the game! Please post to our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1916560/discussions/]Steam discussion board[/url], about anything and everything, including which difficulty mode you like, or which custom setting you feel fits you best!

Changes:
[list]
[*] The difficulty for the campaign levels have been balanced. Overall it should be slightly more difficult, with more enemies spawning that are easier to kill and give less experience. Loot drop rates have also similarly been adjusted.
[*] Damage for lightning bolts have been significantly reduced.
[*] The graphics for "Feisty Fauna" text in the menus have been updated.
[*] Minor improvements to the UI for classic/co-op game mode have been made.
[/list]

notes.title: Campaign / story-mode added to demo

Since our playtest, we have implemented the campaign / story-mode for Feisty Fauna. Now, you can experience Peppermint's story, as she rescues her chicks who have been kidnapped by foxes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42014435/5b39071c8e7767bfb99114034b3a0a756f36a03a.gif[/img]

The campaign begins in the coop where Peppermint, her wife Cocoa, and other characters reside. You can chat with a diverse cast, before heading into Groovy Grassland to rescue the chicks. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42014435/2762227aa29894a06e06d38ae5d7b640c4c55573.png[/img]

We hope you will enjoy the story as much as we have enjoyed writing it! Please let us know what you think by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1916560/discussions/]posting on our discussion board[/url]!

notes.title: Beta playtest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42014435/ca49736b35e4a07b0070b924884530d4b8187e01.png[/img]

We have launched our beta playtest! Thanks to those of you who have signed up 😊 Please try out the playtest version, and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1916560/discussions/0/3821910251192476739/]let us know what you think[/url]!

This beta playtest version is in active development, so bugs probably do exist. We are very keen to hear about any bugs that you encounter, so do let us know!

If you're interested to participate in the playtest, please click "Request access" above, and you should be granted access immediately. Our playtest is set to "Open" so all requests are automatically approved.

The playtest version doesn't have all the features of the beta yet (we're still developing some of them), but it [i]does[/i] have the following:
[list]
[*] Multiplayer (local co-op and online with Steam Remote play-together)
[*] More skills to choose from
[*] A boss fight after the 3 minibosses
[*] Customizable difficulty
[*] and more!
[/list]

Please give it a try and let us know what you think on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1916560/discussions/0/3821910251192476739/]Steam Discussion Board[/url].

notes.title: Beta version coming soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42014435/8e987df348fc583a3288f2e22bc381003abd29d1.gif[/img]

We are hard at work preparing for the beta launch of Feisty Fauna! We will be releasing many new features, including:
[list]
[*] split-screen multiplayer (up to 4 players, local / Steam remote play-together)
[*] cat ninja minions for Vanilla
[*] many more skills
[*] customizable difficulty, so you can adjust the game to be just right for you
[*] damage-over-time effects (e.g., burning from fire)
[*] better telegraphing of attacks (e.g., a circle filling up with red)
[/list]
and more!

As part of our beta launch, we will be removing the following from our demo:
[list]
[*] Halloween world and costumes (don't worry, they'll be back later this year!)
[/list]

Going forward from our beta launch, here are some of the big features we're planning to incorporate soon:
[list]
[*] Honey will be playable and can charm enemies to join her side
[*] A roll/dodge mechanic that you can manually activate (or automatically if you prefer)
[*] Other status effects, e.g., freezing, slime
[/list]

Do let us know (e.g., through the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1916560/discussions/0/3821909708347151263/]Steam Discussion Board[/url]) if there are any big features that you're looking forward to seeing, and/or if you're interested to playtest our beta version before it's launched!

notes.title: Twitch integration bugfix
notes.content: We just made a small bugfix, so the game should no longer freeze if the Twitch connection gets stuck connecting. Do let us know if you notice any bugs, Twitch-related or otherwise!

notes.title: Android demo, and QoL updates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42014435/58e3e4762831e01867514fed8d901c8aa5baed31.png[/img]

We've put Feisty Fauna's [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.atasfun.feistyfaunademo]demo on the Google Play store[/url]. The full game is not planned to be released there, but you can now play the demo on your mobile devices ːsteamhappyː

In addition, we have done a number of Quality-of-Life updates to the demo:
[list]
[*] The player can now be controlled by clicking on the screen to direct where the player should go
[*] Increased font size and visibility of text in level-up perks
[/list]

Other updates and bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Lighting settings were updated to use baked lights
[*] Creatures now use a different method for path-finding that should be faster
[*] Updated grazers (e.g., cows) to have the Idle animation while stationary, instead of foraging which sometimes caused a head bob
[*] Fixed occlusion shading for Halloween creatures
[*] Fixed a bug where the fox boss would keep running while turning in place to face the player before a bite
[/list]

notes.title: More accessibility options
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42014435/1c75af720e2435b958725acd91dc5b2ff0e84c98.gif[/img]

We have added a Graphics Quality setting to the game (high / low), which should allow lower-end computers to play the game more smoothly. If you have an older computer, we would love to hear if the game runs smooth as butter, or stutters.

Changes:
[list]
[*] Added Quality option in the Graphics Settings
[*] Added left/right clickable arrows in Options so mouse users can click them
[/list]

notes.title: Real-time stats added!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42014435/de7b3656e13f8e6059576c213e0572f0fa805be8.png[/img]

We just added a new feature to our demo: real-time statistics of your perks! You can now view the total damage, damage per second, and health gained/mitigated in-game, in real time! Please use the  key, or either shoulder buttons on the gamepad to toggle between different statistics.

We're aware that some perks are [i]slightly[/i] overpowered 😉(ahem, minions). There will be a round of perk balancing after we have added more variety of perks!

Changes:
[list]
[*] Real-time stats can now be toggled with the Tab key, or either shoulder buttons on the gamepad
[*] Player characters no longer wear Halloween costumes by default
[*] You can still toggle between Halloween costumes with the Ctrl key, or any of the 4 buttons on the gamepad
[/list]

notes.title: Dreamhack Beyond Indie Showcase
notes.content:
Feisty Fauna has been selected for the Dreamhack Beyond Indie Showcase, which is happening from October 14 to 23!

To celebrate the Showcase, and also since Halloween is almost here, we have additional costumes for the player characters. Now, both Peppermint (the explosive chicken) and Vanilla (the cat ninja) can have the following costumes:
[list]
[*] Witch hat
[*] Deer antlers
[*] Butterfly wings
[*] Angel wings
[*] Green floating jewel
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42014435/82eed68090e3ed36f836bb20e403beb7fe73e64d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42014435/e11214c15f32dfa4b68eb52da01f22410ce38e07.gif[/img]

When you start a game, a random costume will be selected. You can then toggle between the costumes with tab or control on the keyboard, or any of the four buttons on the gamepad. You will also be able to toggle the costumes off, if you desire.

notes.title: Halloween world added!
notes.content:

We've just released our brand new Halloween event! Play in a new Halloween-themed biome, with unique monsters such as bats, scarecrows, and ghosts, who have new abilities such as cyclones and energy balls! Face new Halloween-themed bosses who have feisty new skills!

Player characters are also now dressed for Halloween: a butterfly costume for Peppermint, and a witch costume for Vanilla.
